create_strict_dataclass: create a strict dataclass with type validation and custom validators on field assignment
validate_typed_dict: validate a dictionary conforms to the types defined in a TypedDict schema
create_validated_field: create a dataclass field with a custom validator function attached in metadata
create_validated_field_decorator: decorate a validator function as a validated_field for use in dataclass fields
validate_type: validate that a value matches an expected type including Union, Literal, list, dict, tuple, and set
